===''Debug Items''===
Various Creative mode tools used for testing.

{|class="fandom-table mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"
!colspan="2"|[[Debug Items]]
|-
! style="width: 170px" |'''Item'''
! style="width: 300px" |'''Usage'''
|-
|[[File:Debug_Item.png|36px]] [[NULL]]
|Shows a list of the targeted Parasite's adaptations. Also serves as the icon for the mod's Creative inventory tab.
|-
|[[File:ItemAssimilation.png|36px]] [[Debug Items#WANDS|Assimilation Wand]]
|Instantly changes a Vanilla mob to its Assimilated form, if applicable. Can disguise said mob as its regular counterpart.
|-
|[[File:ItemEvolution.png|36px]] [[Debug Items#WANDS|Evolution Wand]]
|Instantly evolves a Parasite, if applicable.
|-
|[[File:ItemDevolution.png|36px]] [[Debug Items#WANDS|Devolution Wand]]
|Instantly devolves a Parasite. If the target is at its lowest stage, it will be killed.
|-
|[[File:ItemVariant.png|36px]] [[Debug Items#WANDS|Variant Wand]]
|Cycles between a Parasite's variants.
|-
|[[File:Greek fire.png|36px]] [[Debug Items#GREEK FIRE|Greek Fire]]
|Rapidly burns Parasite foliage.
|-
|[[File:The Sign (Item).png|36px]] [[Debug Items#The Sign|The Sign]]
|Gives its holder [[The Sign]] effect, which makes Parasites ignore the player.
|-
|}
